findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "purchase_persona" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_personas, purchase_persona · Public sink: search_personas.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_personas, purchase_persona · Public sink: search_personas

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
